title: AI Scan for pull requests generally available
key_facts: GitHub made AI Scan for pull requests generally available on 15 Oct 2026.
It complements CodeQL by checking pull request changes in languages CodeQL does not cover, including PHP, Shell/Bash, Terraform (HCL), Dockerfiles, JSP and Blazor.
Findings appear beside CodeQL results with an 'AI' marker and can include an explanation and a suggested fix.
Findings are advisory: they do not fail the code scanning check or block merges.
It does not run on pull requests from forks or from Dependabot.
Free for public repositories; private and internal repositories need GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security; no Copilot licence required.
It consumes Code Security AI Credits, billed usage-based.
quote_evidence: AI Scan findings are advisory. They do not fail the code scanning check and cannot block pull request merges through ruleset requirements.
AI Scan for pull requests consumes Code Security AI Credits.
A GitHub Copilot license is not required.
why_it_matters_hint: Extends automatic security review to languages CodeQL does not support, but results are advisory and cost credits.
